summary.content:
Today's selection covers 73 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 46 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: His Start-Up’s Goal: A.I. That Is Trainable and Not Controlled by a Big Company
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: ‘Zoomsday’ hack uncovered using fewer than 20 AI prompts
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 51 articles published in the last 24 hours
